hazards.control: Hands clear of the injector chains, the reel, and the stripper door.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Reel and levelwind
function: The powered drum that stores the coil and keeps back-tension on it as the injector runs, with a levelwind that lays the pipe evenly.

tabs.overview: The reel does not push or pull the pipe into the well; the injector does. The reel holds tension so the pipe stays wrapped and feeds the gooseneck; the swivel on the reel axle admits pumped fluid to the coil.
tabs.engineering: Capacity per coil size; back-tension setpoints.
tabs.safety: Rotating reel; pinch points at the levelwind.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
